title: OOD model shape + grouped-CV feature selection + domain adaptation on 160 labels
why: Can a fitted model or in-fold selection beat the fixed equal-weight transferable score (0.781 AUROC) under factory-grouped CV?
hypothesis: No: fitted classifiers overfit 22 bad windows; selection is neutral on AUROC, marginally better on balanced error
data: labels/ood160_labels.json (160, 138 good/22 bad, 47 factories) + manifest_gold.json (150 IndEgo); cached Z3-6 + stable-8 features
method: factory-grouped StratifiedGroupKFold(5) OOF; per-domain z-score; IndEgo sign; grouped bootstrap CI

title: Self-training on the 1,546 unlabelled Egocentric-10K windows
why: Does pseudo-labelling the unlabelled pool improve OOD accuracy under factory-grouped CV?
hypothesis: No: the pool is shifted (domain AUROC 0.902) and the base stable-8 model is weak; self-training is <= base
method: per-fold pseudo-label unlabelled windows from non-test factories; retrain; grouped OOF

title: Best OOD score with grouped CI and error-vs-labels curve
why: What is the best honest OOD score and does accuracy improve with more human OOD labels?
hypothesis: Best point estimate is median aggregation 0.785 AUROC (+0.004, ns); label-using recipes plateau below the zero-shot transferable score
data: 160 OOD labels + IndEgo gold; cached features
method: grouped CV + repeated grouped subsampling k=10..160; grouped bootstrap CI

summary: No fitted model beats the equal-weight mean (0.781). Best point estimate median 0.785 (+0.004, ns). Top-12 grouped-CV selection gives best balanced error 0.2592 (BA 0.7408). Features NOT domain-invariant (0.999); per-factory test-time normalization hurts (0.383).
decision: Keep the equal-weight/median transferable score; do not ship fitted classifiers.

summary: Self-training on 1546 unlabelled windows does not help (<= base stable-8 0.7319; pool shifted, domain AUROC 0.902).

Best OOD AUROC 0.7852 [0.649,0.897] (median), +0.004 vs 0.781, not significant; best error 0.2592 (top-12 selection) vs 0.2675. Error-vs-labels curve: label-free score flat; label-using recipes plateau below it.
decision: Report marginal gain honestly; the zero-shot transferable score is near the ceiling for these features.
